verdict.rationale: Fern ships 'Fern Agent,' a built-in assistant that can be scheduled to review reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, and analytics, then autonomously open a pull request when asked — a genuine task-delegation capability inside the product, not just Q&A. However, this is scoped narrowly to docs-maintenance tasks and is only documented via vendor docs/changelog with no independent or hands-on confirmation that delegated tasks are reliably completed. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Fern Agent execution, broader scope of delegable tasks beyond docs upkeep, and details on task reliability/error handling.
